# Test executable text rendering and pe.mod capability vetting.

pe run-text plain.prompt
stdout 'plain text is valid'

pe run-text templated.prompt --var topic=release
stdout 'Review release safely.'

pe run-text templated.prompt --check
stdout 'ok'

! pe run-text templated.prompt
stderr 'missing input topic'

pe run-text composed.prompt --var topic=release
stdout 'Check release first.'

pe mod vet templated.prompt
stdout 'ok'

! pe mod vet denied.prompt
stderr 'provider remote is denied by pe.mod'

-- plain.prompt --
plain text is valid

-- templated.prompt --
#!/usr/bin/env pe run-text
---
kind: pe.text.v1
run: pe run-text
inputs:
  topic:
    type: string
safety:
  providers:
    allow: [local]
---
Review {{ .topic }} safely.

-- composed.prompt --
---
kind: pe.text.v1
inputs:
  topic:
    type: string
imports:
  checker: checker.prompt
---
{{ import "checker" }}

-- checker.prompt --
Check {{ .topic }} first.

-- denied.prompt --
---
kind: pe.text.v1
inputs:
  topic:
    type: string
safety:
  providers:
    allow: [remote]
---
This wants a denied provider.

-- pe.mod --
module example.com/prompts

pe 1

capability {
    providers deny remote
    tools deny shell network
}

policy {
    composition strict
    require-typed-io true
}
